mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_id, started_at, last_activity_at, current_run_no, current_run_started_at, current_run_capability_count, capability_call_count, consecutive_ai_failure_count, stop_requested_at, stop_requested_by, max_capability_calls, max_duration_seconds, agent_step_timeout_seconds, max_consecutive_ai_failures, lock_version FROM investigation WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investigation (incident_id, started_at, last_activity_at, current_run_no, current_run_started_at, current_run_capability_count, capability_call_count, consecutive_ai_failure_count, stop_requested_at, stop_requested_by, max_capability_calls, max_duration_seconds, agent_step_timeout_seconds, max_consecutive_ai_failures, created_at, updated_at, lock_version) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{now}, #{now}, 1, #{now}, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, #{maxCapabilityCalls}, #{maxDurationSeconds}, #{agentStepTimeoutSeconds}, #{maxConsecutiveAiFailures}, #{now}, #{now}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE investigation SET current_run_no = #{nextRunNo}, current_run_started_at = #{now}, current_run_capability_count = 0, consecutive_ai_failure_count = 0, stop_requested_at = NULL, stop_requested_by = NULL, last_activity_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND current_run_no = #{expectedRunNo} AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion}
